scope: Three source-informed development transactions for the raw-print pilot, and one approved redacted UK transaction for Veryfi. No blind holdout, production migration or general accuracy claim.

raw_printed_pilot.decision: Not selected for application integration or a wider v1 cohort; retained as a failed research profile.
source_review: train-004: grouping normalization recovers 43636 and 4364, but final total is wrongly copied from subtotal; GRAND TOTAL, cash and change also become tips, although cash/change are separately listed as payments.

train-003: all three line prices and document amounts are copied, but the raw profile has unknown tax inclusion and the app's current default omits added tax from calculation. The control balances using a Tax fee, not a correct tax classification. Neither is accepted.

UK: raw line totals include A/Z suffixes, so all 22 raw line totals are rejected. Coupons remain purchase rows; Savings, coupon count 4 and future Executive Reward are wrongly made discounts. PricesIncludeTax is incorrectly true.

Both CORD cases infer a printed item count absent from the source. train-003 also supplies unit prices that are not separately printed; its unknown unit-price labels are excluded from accuracy counts.
The v1 prompt has no explicit overlapping-photo deduplication clause. No prompt or sealed request was changed after observing pilot outcomes.
raw_printed_pilot.timing_limit: Fresh model load/encoding/generation, not whole-app latency. Sequential controls first, cache/order and host-load effects; typechecking overlapped part of UK control. No speed gain or p95 claim.

native_structured_fields.reason_unavailable: Native rows can include coupons, summaries or purchases. Unmatched rows require source classification. Native total/gross_total are tested separately against the printed pre-coupon, VAT-exclusive purchase price; no undocumented pre/post-tax or discount conversion is inferred. Separate negative rows are not attached as coupons. No application financial draft is produced.

source_review.first_rows: Tuna description uses SPAM's SKU and 14.99 price; eggs uses tuna's SKU and 9.99 price; a nameless row retains eggs' SKU and 9.99. SPAM description is returned last without price. Matching all 18 names is not correct purchase grouping.

veryfi.ocr_path: No edits, currency hints, native money fields, new inference, coupon repair or balancing. Literal returned ocr_text passed to the unchanged current parser and exact calculator; all 18 purchase quantities/prices/discounts/codes and three document amounts match the pre-existing source-checked label.
veryfi.decision: Promising OCR text on this single redacted development receipt; native structured fields are not suitable to accept directly. No provider selected, app integration or additional upload authorized.
veryfi.privacy_cost: User confirmed unused Free quota. One POST and one scoped cleanup DELETE, no retries/billing activation. Actual billing not inspected. Provider-reported deletion does not establish zero retention or training exclusion.
veryfi.timing_limit: One measured provider transaction including transport and attempted cleanup, not comparable to isolated neural inference or a p95 distribution

same_crop_comparators.local_comparator_scope: Same two exact crop bytes, previously measured inference and later deterministic verifier replay; not fresh paired latency or the different full-photo raw-profile experiment.

gemini.reason: Both separately approved attempts returned HTTP 503; no reading exists to rank against Veryfi.

limits: CORD labels are upstream semantic references, not full new human financial truth. UK labels were source checked by the assistant, not independently verified.
All research drafts remain untrusted with an explicit source-coverage check; a balanced total is not an automatic acceptance.
Original 50, stable branch and original dirty checkout are unchanged. Earlier 13 missing historical QA bytes remain disclosed in the separate integrity checkpoint.
Full twelve-phase production goal remains open. Representative provider comparison, capture improvements and public deployment controls are outstanding.
